name: vsc-python-indent
readme:
# Python Indent

Correct Python indentation on Enter: one level after a colon, aligned inside brackets, hanging indents, and one level less after return, pass or break.

This is the unmodified extension published on Open VSX, pinned to a specific version and verified to work in Diode.

works: Enter indents after a colon, aligns inside brackets, hangs after an opening bracket and dedents after return, pass and break
Comments continue when split, and Enter inside a multi-line string keeps the text intact
An open suggestion popup keeps Enter, and one undo removes the line break with its indent
limits: pythonIndent.useTabOnHangingIndent: Tab does not jump past the closing bracket, Diode has no snippet sessions yet. It inserts indentation as usual
